definition.en: The clear, curved front surface of the eye. It lets light in and bends it.
definition.zh: 眼睛前端透明、弯曲的表面，让光进入并改变方向。

definition.en: The opening in the iris through which light enters the eye.
definition.zh: 虹膜中央让光进入眼内的开口。

definition.en: The coloured ring that controls the size of the pupil opening.
definition.zh: 调节瞳孔开口大小的有色环形结构。

definition.en: A clear structure inside the eye. It works with the cornea to focus light and changes shape to focus at different distances.
definition.zh: 眼内的透明结构，与角膜共同聚焦光线。它改变形状，帮助看清不同距离的物体。

definition.en: The thin, light-sensitive layer at the back inside the eye. Its cells begin turning light into electrical signals.
definition.zh: 眼内后部薄薄的感光组织，其中细胞开始把光转成电信号。

definition.en: The nerve carrying signals from the retina towards the brain.
definition.zh: 把视网膜信号传向大脑的神经。

definition.en: Short-sightedness: light from distant objects focuses in front of the retina, so distant things can look blurred.
definition.zh: 远处来的光聚在视网膜前，使远物可能看起来模糊的情况。

definition.en: The thin membrane at the end of the ear canal that vibrates in response to incoming sound.
definition.zh: 外耳道尽头随传来声音振动的薄膜。

definition.en: The three connected middle-ear bones: malleus, incus and stapes.
definition.zh: 中耳里相连的锤骨、砧骨与镫骨的合称。

definition.en: The ossicle whose handle contacts the eardrum and whose head meets the incus.
definition.zh: 柄部接鼓膜、头部与砧骨相接的听小骨。

definition.en: The middle bone in the ossicle chain. It links the malleus to the stapes.
definition.zh: 听骨链中间的一块骨，连接锤骨与镫骨。

definition.en: The stirrup-shaped ossicle whose footplate moves at the oval window.
definition.zh: 形似马镫、底板在卵圆窗处活动的听小骨。

definition.en: The curled, fluid-filled hearing structure in the inner ear. Its sensory structures help turn movement into signals.
definition.zh: 内耳中卷曲、充满液体的听觉结构，其中感受结构帮助把运动转成信号。

definition.en: A sensory cell with a bundle of tiny hair-like projections. Bending the bundle helps start electrical signals. These projections differ from ordinary hairs.
definition.zh: 顶部带微小毛发状突起束的感受细胞。小束弯曲帮助启动电信号，突起与普通毛发不同。

definition.en: The nerve carrying hearing signals from the inner ear towards the brain.
definition.zh: 把内耳听觉信号传向大脑的神经。

definition.en: How many times a motion repeats in a given time. Hertz counts cycles per second.
definition.zh: 一定时间内运动重复的次数。赫兹表示每秒重复多少次。

definition.en: The greatest distance from the rest position during a back-and-forth movement. Here it measures relative particle movement, rather than decibels.
definition.zh: 来回运动时离开静止位置的最大距离。这里表示粒子的相对运动幅度，不是分贝。

definition.en: The perceived highness or lowness of a sound, related to frequency.
definition.zh: 声音听起来高或低的感觉，与频率有关。
